title: John Eglinton asked with elder’s gall
html_source:
Pen name of W.K. Magee,

a tee totalling fun free critic and essayist whom Joyce read but ‘became a favourite butt of Joyce and Gogarty’ to the point Joyce made up a limerick about him :

There once was a Celtic librarian
Whose essays were voted Spencerian
His name is Magee
But it seems that to me
He’s a flavour that’s more Presbyterian.

Ellmann, R. James Joyce, p118.

See also a letter to him from Joyce.
